Who we serve

Reusable drinkware for hotels, resorts and pool operations

Outdoor beverage service fails for two reasons: the glass breaks, or the replacement does not match what you already own. Both are solvable with moulded drinkware and a supplier who holds the tooling.

Request a quoteBrowse the catalogue

What usually goes wrong

The five problems we hear most from this buyer type.

  • Breakage rates and glass-hazard incidents at pool bars
  • Replacement orders that do not match the original glass
  • Glasses that cloud or craze under commercial dishwashing
  • Guest complaints about drinking from something that feels cheap
  • Procurement cycles that cannot take a 30-day lead time

Solve the glass ban without lowering the standard

Pool decks, beach clubs, rooftop terraces and poolside cabanas are where glass simply cannot go. Moulded drinkware removes the hazard entirely while keeping the profile and clarity a four-star guest expects. The Tritan range is the closest match to crystal without being crystal, and it survives commercial washing without clouding — the failure mode that makes most plastic glassware look tired within a season.

For indoor restaurants and lobby bars, the same shapes in PS or acrylic give you a matched house glass across the whole beverage programme at a unit cost that makes breakage irrelevant.

Specification consistency is the real deliverable

The complaint we hear most from hospitality buyers is not about the first order, it is about the third. A replacement arrives lighter, or with a thicker rim, or in a carton count that breaks the storeroom plan. Because the moulds are ours, we hold the specification: the same wall thickness, the same base weight, the same box count across every run, so the glass on a guest's table in June is the same as the one they used in March.

Every specification we quote — material, capacity, unit weight, carton count — is printed on the product page and repeated on the order confirmation, so procurement can reorder from a reference rather than from a memory.

Procurement that fits around a season

We hold stock on high-rotation shapes and confirm dispatch per SKU against stock status and quantity. If you are preparing for a peak season, place the pre-season order with a sample approval gate and we will hold the schedule. Custom logo versions for house-branded service and in-room amenities can be produced in the same run as the plain stock.

Talk to us about your programme

Send the item list, quantities, decoration and destination. We reply with pricing by volume tier, lead time and carton data.

Reusable drinkware for hotels, resorts and pool operations — questions

Which material should a hotel choose?

Use Tritan for pool decks, beach clubs and outdoor service where repeat-wash durability matters most. Use PS or acrylic for indoor bars and restaurants where the priority is the closest glass look at the lowest replacement cost.

Will the glass cloud after commercial dishwashing?

Tritan and PP resist clouding under repeated commercial cycles. PET is not designed for hot cycles and should be hand washed if you want a long service life.

How do you keep the specification the same on reorders?

Each order is produced against the approved brief: the SKU, the mould record, the material, the decoration method, the Pantone reference and the packing configuration. Every run is checked against the approved pre-production sample before it is packed, which is what makes a reorder reproducible rather than a new interpretation.

Do you supply house-branded glassware?

Yes. Logo printing, laser engraving and electroplating are available, along with custom colour matching to your property's palette. The minimum for each decoration method is confirmed per SKU and per decoration method in the quotation.

What are the lead times and payment terms?

FOB dispatch is confirmed per SKU — 10–15 days for a no-stock small batch, 15–25 days at 1,000 pcs and above, and 45–60 working days for no-stock electrical products. These are dispatch times only, not transit or delivery-to-door times. Terms are 30% deposit with the balance before shipment.

How do we keep specifications stable across reorders?

The SKU, mould record, material, case pack and approved pre-production sample are kept with the order documentation. Reorders are produced against that approved brief so rim, weight and box count do not drift between deliveries.

About the factory

What care information do you provide for the housekeeping team?

Care guidance is given per material. Confirm the washing method used on property so we recommend the material that suits that cycle, and the applicable care instruction is stated with the quotation.
